                                             TECHNICAL
                                  POLICY AND PROCEDURE NOTICE #2/99



   TO:             Distribution

   FROM:           Richard C. Visconti, R.A.

   DATE:           January 28, 1999

   SUBJECT: TESTING OF GAS PRESSURE



   EFFECTIVE:             Immediately

   REFERENCE:             Administrative Code Section 27-922(d)(1)(a)

   PURPOSE:               To permit the testing of gas pressure using gauges other than mercury gauges
                          in order to reduce the potential hazard posed by equipment containing
                          mercury.

   SPECIFICS:

   Conversion Factor: A pressure of six (6) inches (15.24 cm) of mercury is equivalent to 3 psig
   (20.68 kPa).

   Requirements: A gas pressure of 3 psig (20.68 kPa) taken using a spring or digital gauge for a
   minimum of 30 minutes is equivalent to a gas pressure of six (6) inches (15.24 cm) of mercury taken
   using a mercury gauge for a minimum of 30 minutes.

   The appropriate reading may be taken using a mercury, spring, or digital gauge.
